title: Center Introduction Step Count Chip
description: Ensure the step-count chip in the introduction window footer stays centered in the full window regardless of whether navigation chips exist on the left, right, both sides, or neither side.
summary: Emphasized introduction step count text color on hover by adding group-hover:text-emphasized and transition-colors class names to the step count span inside the footerCenterChips of UIIntroduction. Added a unit test to verify that these hover emphasis classes are rendered correctly on the step count span.
